Nonland mana sources that can tap for at least {4} on the battlefield.

description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal, holding priority.
Tap Lithoform Engine and spend {3} to activate the second ability of Lithoform Engine, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Allow the Dramatic Reversal copy to resolve, untapping your nonland permanents.
Tap your nonland mana sources for at least {4}.
Repeat steps 2-4 for an infinite loop.
